cd /workspace/tmp/t && cat > t2.py <<'EOF'
from run import *

# LAYOUT: A packet not final -> all packets dropped LAYOUT
show("layout", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}]), pk("A",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    dg(1,[pk("A",0,[{"type":"PING"}]), pk("I",1,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
])]})

# INITIAL_TOO_SMALL
show("small initial", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("I",0,[{"type":"PING"}]), pk("H",0,[{"type":"PING"}])], size=1199),
])]})

# EARLY_REJECTED (early=false)
show("early rejected", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("Z",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
])]})

# early=true: Z accepted
show("early accepted", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("Z",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
], early=True)]})

# KEYS_DISCARDED: queue H packets then discard H
show("keys discarded", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("H",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    {"t":1,"op":"key","level":"H","action":"discard"},
    dg(2,[pk("H",1,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    {"t":3,"op":"key","level":"H","action":"install"},
])]})

# BUFFER_FULL
show("buffer full", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("H",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    dg(1,[pk("H",1,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    dg(2,[pk("H",2,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
], buffer_packets=1)]})

# buffered at EOF
show("buffered eof", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(5,[pk("H",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
])]})

# idle timeout
show("idle", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    {"t":0,"op":"tick"},
    {"t":100,"op":"tick"},
], idle_ms=10)]})

# idle timeout with pending packets
show("idle with pending", {"version":1,"traces":[trace("a",[
    dg(0,[pk("H",0,[{"type":"PING"}])]),
    {"t":100,"op":"tick"},
], idle_ms=10)]})
EOF
python3 t2.py 2>&1 | head -250
